assumptions.text: the answer's value carries the release's TieredNode form unchanged, so a leaf answers {_tier, value} under the answer's own value
assumptions.alternative: flattening the node into the arm as {status, kind, path, _tier, value}, which collides with the answer's own members for an object node and gives the surface a SECOND spelling of a shape the package already declares (D-53, D-134)

assumptions.text: the seam gains no byte: the typed verb reaches src/main/data/ through ProfileStore and the S-9 census is the pin
assumptions.alternative: a declared seam accessor mirroring commitLog, which existed because that member was UNTYPED — a typed member removes an assertion and not a function (D-103, D-134)

assumptions.text: the absent and DataLedger arms gain nothing
assumptions.alternative: carrying the caller's tier on them as D-133 first proposed, which states the ARGUMENT rather than the answer and makes every refusal claim something about a store it never reached (D-107, D-134)

assumptions.text: only T-6's boot waits for the renderer realm, because the other seven rows read what main answers over stdio and that surface stands before the window does
assumptions.alternative: a renderer wait on every boot, which binds a fact those rows do not claim and spends the bound's whole margin per row (D-27, D-94)
